intro.title: Before your first goal in this project
intro.lead: Orchestra turns a goal into a few ordinary tasks. Nothing runs until you click Plan goal below, and nothing but the planner runs until you approve its plan.

happensItems.plan: A planner reads the project and proposes tasks: {{cost}}, up to {{ceiling}}.
happensItems.planNoCeiling: A planner reads the project and proposes tasks: {{cost}}.
happensItems.approve: You read the plan and approve it with one click, or change it first.
happensItems.order: Tasks run in order, at most {{atOnce}} at once, each with its own crew and worktree.
happensItems.branch: Finished work is merged into one goal branch in Crewyard's own worktree, then a last review reads all of it.

yoursItems.reports: Passing research results to tasks that write code
yoursItems.spend: Spend past the goal budget or any cap

settings.enabledHint: Off hides Orchestra in the composer and refuses new goals; the composer opens on Crew. Goals you already approved keep running in their order.
settings.pauseAllHint: Stops every goal in every project at once: running goal steps and planning runs pause at their next turn boundary, and no goal task or planning run starts. Tasks outside goals keep running.
settings.pausedHint: On: no goal task or planning run starts, and the status bar says Goals paused. Lifting it is your click.
